}}{{Quote|Don't be too hard on our resident geologist. He's a lot better with rocks then he is with people.|[[Maniks|Doctor Maniks]] about Professor Cavalz|<ref name="Wreckage on Dantooine">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Wreckage on Dantooine|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref>}}
'''Cavalz''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Professor/Legends|professor]] [[Geologist/Legends|geologist]] who was present at the [[Jannimak crash site|''Jannimak'' crash site]] in the [[Geothermal Disruption]] area on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]<ref name="Geothermal">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=location|[[Geothermal Disruption]]|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref> around [[3622 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.8}}</ref> While studying the effects of [[Jannimak]]'s excavating that critically destabilized the area and caused a poisonous chemical runoff,<ref name="Wreckage on Dantooine" /> he found a "special rock" which highly fascinated him.<ref name="datapad Cavalz1">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=other|datapad "Research Log: Entry 0057" located in the [[Geothermal Disruption]] forward camp}}</ref> He convinced several other scientists of the unique significance of this rock, which he called the "universal rock". [[Naul|Professor Naul]], Cavalz's fellow researcher at the Geothermal Disruption, conveyed his concerns about Cavalz's rock obsession in his personal journal.<ref name="datapad Naul">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=other|datapad "Personal Research Journal Entry: 039" located in the [[Geothermal Disruption]] forward camp}}</ref> Afraid for the rock, Professor Cavalz put up a sign to protect it.<ref name="datapad Cavalz1" />

The story with the rock seemed to damage Cavalz's authority, so when his calculations indicated that the fumes generated by the toxic runoff would soon spread to other areas with potentially catastrophic results, such as poisoning of snow or acceleration of unpredictable spore mutations in the adjacent [[Glacial Trespass]] and [[Sporefall]] zones, Cavalz's findings were ignored by his fellow scientists.<ref name="datapad Cavalz2">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=other|datapad "Research Log: Entry 0147" located in the [[Geothermal Disruption]] forward camp}}</ref> [[Naul|Professor Naul]] however noted in his journal, that these findings are worth looking into.<ref name="datapad Naul" />

Around the same time, Cavalz's team he sent to deploy stabilization struts, stumbled upon a lone [[Graul/Legends|Graul]], a giant creature native to [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. Graul was attacked by [[Jannimak]]'s droids, but [[Galactic Sustainability Institute|GSI]] contractors defended it.<ref name="Fungal Protection">{{TORcite|[[Graul]] Graveyard|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]|exp=lots|type=dynamic}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Cavalz first appeared in Game Update 7.8: ''Pursuit of Ruin'', released on [[December 9]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Pursuit of Ruin">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20251209-2|text=Game Update 7.8 "Pursuit of Ruin" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
